turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm trying to get more vegetables into my week and I've got three plans in mind.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me finish describing every option before you respond.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Plan A is a big soup on Sunday that I eat for lunch every day, mostly lentils, carrots and greens.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Plan B is sneaking veg into everything, like grated courgette in sauces and spinach in my eggs.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Plan C is a veg box delivery, which forces me to cook whatever turns up each week, even weird stuff.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Alright, I'm finished. What's your opinion?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Plan B is the easiest to stick with because it doesn't change what you already eat. The Sunday soup is great but you might be bored by Thursday. The veg box is the most adventurous, and good if you like a challenge.
